exposure: Group 4 (multiparous women without previous cesarean section with induced labor or cesarean section before labor)
Group 5 (multiparous women with a previous cesarean section)
Group 2 (nulliparous women with induced labor or cesarean section before labor)
cohort: 186 women who underwent cesarean sections at a public normal-risk maternity hospital in Curitiba, Brazil.
finding: The most common reasons for cesarean section referral were complications of labor, maternal conditions, and fetal conditions.
